---
title: "Which elements can be detected with LIBS ?"
date: 2018-09-19
description: "Overview of the elements detectable by LIBS in biological tissues and the sensitivities relevant to biomedical elemental imaging."
categories: [LIBS, Elemental Imaging, Methods]
---

In principle, **LIBS can detect a very broad range of chemical elements**. This archived note highlighted the elements already detected in biological tissues and the analytical sensitivities relevant to biomedical elemental imaging.

The discussion was linked to our review of LIBS for biological and medical applications.

DOI: [10.1016/j.ccr.2017.12.006](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ccr.2017.12.006).
